insight: Gives you durable, resumable functions — retries, sleeps, fan-out — without standing up a queue or worker pool yourself.
name: Inngest
tagline: Durable workflow engine for AI background jobs.
description: Event-driven, durable execution engine — pause/resume, retries, fan-out, scheduling — designed for long-running AI jobs that can't sit in a request/response cycle. TypeScript-first; framework-agnostic.
